summary: Neuraxis Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a stock option exchange and new RSU grants. The company cancelled 1,319,394 outstanding stock options and issued an equal number of RSUs on a one-for-one basis, effective July 24, 2026. Executives received RSUs with immediate vesting, and additional time-vested RSUs were granted on August 13 plus one-time director equity awards. The transaction reduces share overhang from options but is not a tender offer or buyback.
